title: Massive MSFS Marketplace Update: New Airline Schedules & Realistic Hub Traffic
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the clutter on the virtual storefront? The marketplace just dropped a massive fleet and schedule update, and if you love real-world operations, commercial scheduling, and immersive airline flying, you are completely spoiled for choice.

Today, we are bypassing the long store menu to break these new additions down into logical categories so you can plan your next big airline itinerary. We focus on the high-value bundles, the summer mainline schedule refresh, and the massive global hub traffic overhauls for major international airports like London Gatwick and Chicago O'Hare.

We dive into the details on:

Historical Master Collections: Looking at the "100 Years of Lufthansa" and Perfect Flight’s new "Air Master Collection" bundles.

Summer Schedule Refresh: A breakdown of new routing packages for China Eastern, Qatar, Ryanair, United, and Virgin Australia.

Airport Traffic Overhauls: How to inject realistic life into mega-hubs like KORD, EGKK, RJAA, OMAA, and YMML.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know if these add-ons are worth the investment for your simulator!
